referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The source is a digital coaching product. Its long page begins with a compact announcement and oversized training promise over a lifestyle image, with a device mockup crossing the hero boundary. A centered product-value chapter introduces a wide benefit carousel, followed by a trainer introduction, an individualized roadmap, member stories/results, a coach-finding action, and a multi-column product footer. Mobile keeps the device preview close to the headline, stacks the roadmap inputs, and compresses coach/testimonial sections into a single column. Treat source copy, images, identity, product details, prices, and results as off-limits for a new local business.

acceptanceChecks: The initial viewport has a clear training promise, an early action, and a bounded product preview.
Feature exploration, coaching/process, roadmap, proof, and discovery follow in a purposeful sequence.
At 390 px the page stays within the viewport, with user-controlled carousel and stacked roadmap.
The reference is tagged as digital coaching, not a local gym, and no source brand or content is reused.
New local business copy, contact details, location, classes, and claims are bound only to verified client facts.

review.notes: Direct page screenshots verified at 1440 and 390. No width overflow. Four desktop Cloudinary workout-card requests plus an empty image source were unresolved; mobile had one Cloudinary request and several empty src nodes. No source assets were downloaded. User-attested permission, no owner grant file.
